{{Term/Store|Stealth Up||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}}</ref>

==Overview==
Stealth Up is an [[Added Effect]] that reduces the sound that [[Link]] makes by 20%, 40%, and 70% for levels one, two, and three respectively. It does not affect visual detection by [[Enemy|Enemies]], and it has a maximum potency of level three. However, all levels of Stealth Up are negated if Link [[Sprinting|Sprints]] or swings a melee [[Weapon]].

==Trivia==
* In {{BotW}}, the Stealth Up [[Added Effect]] will also muffle the sounds made by [[Link]]'s [[Equipment]] as he moves around. This feature was removed in {{TotK}}.
